scope: Real LX7 instructions: exact route/mux/address NACK, RTC time+STOP, TCA9555 keys+codec ports, actualRMT RGB bytes, Relay1 GPIO47, distinct eight-channel control, five actual guest1bit SDMMC IDMAC512-byte roundtrip/wrong-route/eject.
clippy: cargo clippy --release -p esp32s3 --test waveshare_industrial_controls -- -D warnings: passed
limitations: Only GPIO47 coil control is observed after correct mux/direction. Contact continuity, isolation, voltage/current/load switching are not simulated.
RS485 UART17/18 and DE21 physical wiring is documented; no remote Modbus/serial peer or network is synthesized.
Source-bounded digital subset only. Original factory execution, browser/WebGL and physical hardware acceptance are separate; no complete compatibility claim.
